Marginal future-outcome prediction intervals for Gaussian FPCR

etr_fpca_regression_future_prediction_interval.Rd

Applies the published Python 1.2 centered empirical residual resampling and percentile-calibration law to retained paired-bootstrap conditional-mean predictions. It assumes exchangeable response residuals and reports marginal intervals for individual targets. An integer seed with the default engine reproduces NumPy's first spawned SeedSequence stream for the residual indices.

Usage

etr_fpca_regression_future_prediction_interval(
  result, outcome, confidence_level = 0.95,
  residual_method = "empirical_centered", random_state = 0L,
  residual_indices = NULL, random_engine = "numpy",
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE
)

Arguments

result

Retained Gaussian FPCR paired-bootstrap uncertainty record.

outcome

Training outcomes matching the reference fitted responses.

confidence_level

Marginal predictive interval coverage probability.

residual_method

Must equal "empirical_centered".

random_state

Nonnegative integer seed below 2^53 for a spawned NumPy-compatible PCG64 stream. NULL uses the current R RNG stream.

residual_indices

Optional zero-based B-by-target source index matrix allowing exact numerical replay of pinned Python residual draws.

random_engine

Use "numpy" for source-seeded residual draws or "base_R" to reproduce previous native seeded draws.

python_boundary_mode

If TRUE, apply the explicitly requested frozen Python 1.2 boundary semantics; FALSE retains strict native defaults.

Value

Source-shaped marginal future-outcome predictive draws, limits, medians, pointwise sample standard deviations and scientific provenance.
